name: Espe S.p.A.
summary: ESPE S.p.A. is a global provider of end-to-end services for industrial electrical systems, from manufacturing and setup to ongoing operation. The company's capabilities include the design and implementation of solar power installations, both rooftop and ground-mounted configurations, as well as the creation of customized electrical plants. Furthermore, ESPE S.p.A. manufactures equipment for diverse renewable energy sectors, specifically producing turbines for small to medium-scale wind power and hydroelectric facilities, alongside biomass co-generation units. The firm, founded in 1974, is headquartered in Grantorto, Italy.
